landscape_environment.note: Mountain slope, cave/rocky summit and Kolli landscape are explicit.

fauna.note: Elephant, tiger-like `உழுவை`, deer, boar, monitor lizard and deer-derived food are retained as exact source fauna/hunting evidence.

people_social_roles.note: Hunter, killer/ruler, `விறலி`, performers and ruler/patron roles are retained.

relationships.note: Recognition, praise, gift exchange and the ruler's interaction with performers/speaker are explicit relational evidence.

emotion_lived_experience.note: Wonder, uncertainty over identity and the ruler's shame at his own name being spoken are retained as lived experience.

occupations_production.note: `வல்வில் வேட்டம்` and the hunting sequence are explicit hunting/production evidence.

food_subsistence.note: Venison/fat preparation and drink are explicit food/subsistence evidence.

clothing_ornaments_adornment.note: Chest ornament, gold and gems are retained as explicit adornment/valuable material evidence.

material_culture_everyday_objects.note: Arrow/bow, performance instruments, gold and gem objects are explicit material culture.

weapons_warfare.note: Arrow, strong bow and killing action are explicit weapon/combat evidence; hunting is not reclassified as formal war beyond the source weapon use.

mobility_transport.note: Movement from place to place and gift-giving in the pass are retained as mobility evidence.

economy.note: Food, drink, gold and gem gifts are explicit patronage/distribution evidence.

polity_political_life.note: Mountain ruler/Ori polity evidence is retained as printed without external identity resolution.

communities_social_groups.note: `வேட்டுவர்` and source-note `வேட்டுவக் குடியினன்` are retained exactly without later identity substitution.

arts_music_performance.note: `விறலி`, drum/yāḻ/wind/percussion instruments and performance instructions are explicit.

knowledge_technology.note: Hunting skill and coordinated instrument/performance practice are retained as source-level practical/technical knowledge.

values_ethical_concepts.note: Praise, humility/shame, refusal to let the visitors leave and generous giving are retained as evaluative/value evidence.

body_health.note: `மார்பு` is retained as explicit body evidence; no broader health inference is made.
